name: Elk
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: v2 pp. 230–231, with Giant Elk cross-reference p. 236, Elk Traits.
heading: Elk Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: Giant Elk explicitly refers back to Elk rather than providing another player race. This NPC uses the base Elk. Both forms use the Medium player block.
The 2014 rules treat unarmed strikes as melee weapon attacks, so the Strength-based ram qualifies for Charge. Knockdown uses a separate bonus action and a contested shove.

name: Giant Badger
author: Tyler Kamstra
heading: Giant Badger Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: The design notes mention No Hands, but the printed Giant Badger player traits omit that rule. The NPC uses no weapons, shields, or other hand-dependent gear.
Badger has its own distinct player trait block. The giant build uses the Strength and Constitution increases printed on p. 232.

name: Giant Bat
author: Tyler Kamstra
heading: Giant Bat Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: The printed trait block sets the bite die to 1d8. The design notes say 1d6.
Bat's separate trait block supplies no rules to this Giant Bat build.

name: Giant Crab
author: Tyler Kamstra
heading: Giant Crab Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: The printed Claw grants finesse but omits the encounter giant crab's automatic grapple. Crab has a different player block.
The monk uses the 1d6 piercing claw on the Attack action. Under the supplement's p. 7 clarification, the Martial Arts bonus strike uses a kick with the monk die for bludgeoning.

name: Giant Goat
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: v2 p. 237, with Goat cross-reference p. 248, Giant Goat Traits.
heading: Giant Goat Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: Goat explicitly refers to Giant Goat. This is a single player trait block and the worked character is the Giant Goat.
The 2014 unarmed ram is a melee weapon attack and can trigger Charge. The player version lacks the encounter Giant Goat's forced-prone rider.
The source's p. 8 permits form-appropriate somatic components. The druid prepares spells with no material components.
